title: Wiring up your AI with Breadboard by Dimitri Glazkov
description:
Everyone is tinkering and exploring the new frontier of AI that is LLMs and the systems popping up around them. With all of the options, and the weekly changing landscape, how best do you explore this world? Breadboard, a Google Labs driven project you may have not heard of. Dimitri will show you the world of Breadboard and the patterns of AI he has found along the way as he builds the most flexible system out there.

Dimitri works at Google Labs, trying to glimpse the future by building things and seeing if they work. Fascinated by the potential of Generative AI, he spends most of his time making LLMs do interesting things -- hence the whole Breadboard thing.
